name: Enterprise Blue
tagline: Blue gradient cover and section dividers, white content slides with soft shadow cards, pale dot grid and thin arc lines.

palette.description: White content pages with Alipay-style blue gradient covers and dividers.

typography.style: Single neutral sans in heavy headings and regular body; replaces the original Chinese font stack.

best_for: Information-dense enterprise decks that need many card, step and keyword layouts under a calm blue brand look. Good for reviews, briefings and roadmaps.
avoid_for: Emotional storytelling or design-led keynotes that need a distinctive personality.
